attribution: AISHELL-3, Beijing Shell Shell Technology Co., Ltd.; Yao Shi, Hui Bu, Xin Xu, Shaoji Zhang, Ming Li, 2020, https://arxiv.org/abs/2010.11567
selection: First two lexicographically ordered train utterances between 441000 and 990000 bytes from each of SSB0009 and SSB0011; selected by duration proxy before inference, not model results. This longer-turn control does not replace the short-utterance test.
modifications: Resample to mono 16 kHz PCM16; alternate four distinct utterances A/B/A/B with 600 ms gaps. No voice conversion or repeated audio. Temporary audio is not redistributed.
